plan.allowedPublicFields: Baryon-authored protocol, code hashes, lifecycle timing, request budget and review status only. No returned facility names, IDs, coordinates, contacts, compliance findings, quantities or response bodies are exported.
plan.decisionEffect: Even a positive identity lead resolves no supply gate. A dated source-backed physical process link, actual output, product specification, allocation and delivery still require separate review.

evaluation.comparison: Single exploratory source screen; no control policy, causal effect or improvement estimate.
evaluation.duplicateRule: A byte-identical body already recorded in this acquisition ledger is not new evidence. A completed or interrupted attempt consumes the one-request budget; changing the plan ID or retrying the URL is not supported.

limitations: The name/state search may miss aliases or relevant facilities, or return unrelated names. A null result is not evidence that a facility does not exist.
FRS identifiers join administrative program records; a name, permit, status or industry code does not by itself establish an electrowinning plant, operating measurement or physical transfer.
Candidate discovery is not source admission. New downloads and a positive source screen are not model gains or measured research-policy improvement.

The local journal detects edits relative to its retained hashes; its owner could replace local history. The published checkpoint is an external reference, not cryptographic proof of every prior action.

primaryOutcome.rule: A complete HTTP 200 JSON response with Results.Message equal to Success, a Facilities array and a nonnegative integer QueryRows string; at least one distinct 12-digit RegistryID with a FacName containing GUNNISON (case-insensitive) and FacState AZ. The evaluator records only a reviewable lead, not a verified physical refinery.

plan.priorExposure: Only official service documentation, schema, data-scope and policy pages were inspected before registration. No target facility query or response has been accessed. Earlier USGS, MSHA and EPA-permit reviews are already known and are not prospective trial outcomes.
plan.publicationRule: Publish and verify this frozen plan before starting the target request. Record the live snapshot checksum and deployment commit locally. Local timestamps alone are not an independent preregistration proof.
plan.question: Does one documented public facility search return reviewable identity candidates for Gunnison in Arizona?
plan.scope: Prospective source-discovery screen for the unresolved physical-facility identity prerequisite of the current-operations check. It is not a model benchmark or a test of current cathode output.

source.name: EPA ECHO All Media Facility Search
source.permissionStatus: Public query service documented. Commercial redistribution of returned facility records has not been established; raw records remain local pending review.

plan.stopRule: Stop after one request or any access challenge, redirect, error or size/time limit. No pagination, alternate endpoint, repeated download or automatic polling. An interrupted request is not retried.
